sprint_goal: Ship v2.6: eliminate Base44 SDK dependencies in Reports and Signals, stand up a runnable CI pytest suite with fee drag coverage, deliver Trade History UX polish per locked design spec, and close carry-forward governance debt patches CF-1 and CF-2 from v2.5.

ST-01.notes: api.analytics.metrics(period) added to base44Client.js; Reports Performance tab fetches from /analytics/metrics; period selector maps to backend period params; ExportModal uses backend-sourced trade data

ST-02.notes: Confirmed pre-existing: base44.entities.Signal.update() → PATCH /signals/:id (FastAPI); base44.entities.Position.create() → POST /portfolio/position (FastAPI). No Base44 mutation calls remain.

ST-03.notes: Replaced base44.entities.Portfolio.list() with api.cash.getSummary() → GET /cash/summary; availableCash uses current_cash field from authoritative backend

ST-04.notes: conftest.py created; test_alerts_service.py and test_service_coverage.py extended with augment-safe stub pattern; 129 tests pass, 0 collection errors

ST-05.notes: .github/workflows/ci-tests.yml created; Phase A runs 7 test files including test_trade_service.py with dummy DATABASE_URL; triggers on PR to main/develop and push to exec/**

ST-06.notes: tests/e2e/fee-drag-trade-history.spec.js created covering SC-FEE-01 to SC-FEE-04 via page.route() mocking; docs/testing/fee-drag-scenarios.md created with SC-FEE-01 to SC-FEE-06 automation entries confirmed

ST-07.notes: tests/test_trade_service.py created; 17 tests cover SC-FEE-05 (formula correctness, None guards) and SC-FEE-06 (avg aggregation); augment-safe stub pattern, no live DB calls; all 17 pass

ST-08.notes: StatsCard tooltip prop added; Info icon renders when tooltip present; Avg Fee Drag card wired with canonical tooltip text

ST-09.notes: 7-card stats bar: grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 xl:grid-cols-7; Total Trades card added; md:p-3 padding on all cards

ST-10.notes: TH_CLASS = font-semibold text-slate-300 tracking-wide px-2 whitespace-nowrap; TD_CLASS = px-2; all headers and cells updated
